global_principles.anchor_definition: A single, physically observable, filmable element that persists across START -> EVOLVE -> END and undergoes physical transformation, perceptual reframing, or both.
global_visual_constraints: no sci-fi unless grounded in real natural phenomena
anonymous human fragments only if necessary
no yacht names or registration numbers
video_generation_readiness_rules: Each scene prompt must describe only visible, filmable content.
Each scene prompt must include a clear shot type.
Each scene prompt must include the physical continuity anchor and its current state.
Each scene prompt must include camera position and camera movement.
Each scene prompt must describe a visible physical or perceptual transformation.
Each scene prompt must describe concrete lighting, not symbolic light.
Avoid metaphors, abstract interpretation, emotional narration and poetic conclusions.
Avoid generic ocean beauty, generic calmness and generic atmosphere.
Avoid language that only describes mood rather than what the camera sees.
Final prompts should be usable directly in video generation tools such as Kling, Veo, Sora or Seed.
Each scene prompt must be self-contained and usable as an independent video-generation prompt.
Do not rely on previous scenes with phrases such as 'the same object', 'the same pebble', 'this object', 'it', or 'as before' in final scene prompts.
Repeat the physical continuity anchor explicitly in every scene prompt using concrete visual description.
Do not include raw anchor IDs with underscores inside final scene prompts.
Translate anchor IDs into concrete physical visual descriptions in every final scene prompt.
Avoid stillness clichés such as 'water is still' or 'still sea' unless the visible physical process requires it.

sage.reading: Observation, clarity, hidden order, patience, comprehension. Sage shows a subtle natural structure becoming readable through stillness and attention. The transformation is mainly perceptual: an object or mark is reread at different scales.
anchor_principles: Use a tangible object or readable natural sign.
Prefer detail-to-whole scale shift.
The same object or mark must be reread across all three scenes.
Avoid atmospheric revelation.
Zen references are conceptual only, not a literal style requirement.

allowed_thread_anchors.name: smooth_oval_pebble_suiseki
allowed_thread_anchors.physical_description: dark oval smooth pebble, palm-sized, glossy when wet, matte when dry
allowed_thread_anchors.start_state: macro on anonymous hand lifting the wet pebble from the shoreline, droplets visible
allowed_thread_anchors.evolve_state: the pebble is held in foreground against the sea horizon, its silhouette aligning with a distant curve
allowed_thread_anchors.end_state: the pebble is placed on a larger shore rock; the wide shot reveals a scale rhyme with the sea and distant land
allowed_thread_anchors.generator_prompt_seed: smooth dark oval pebble, wet surface, anonymous hand, sea horizon alignment, soft diffused daylight

allowed_thread_anchors.start_state: the branch rests alone on wet sand with a precise shadow
allowed_thread_anchors.evolve_state: the branch is lifted in anonymous POV and aligned with a distant coastline or promontory
allowed_thread_anchors.end_state: the branch is planted vertically in wet sand, becoming a small measure of the surrounding landscape

allowed_thread_anchors.name: single_vertical_reed

allowed_thread_anchors.start_state: detail on the reed grain and nodes, vertical line against horizontal sand

preferred_transformations: object in hand -> object aligned with landscape -> object released into landscape
sage.known_failure_mode: cloud gap -> light column -> luminous path to horizon

explorer.reading: Threshold, movement, orientation, discovery, passage. Explorer should make route and direction visible through a physical navigational sign or yacht-adjacent object.
anchor_principles: Anchor must function as vector, instrument or threshold.
Prefer contemporary yacht materials: teak, brushed steel, white rope.
Traditional elements can be accents only.
The yacht may be implied, not shown as a full product.
Always imply direction or movement.

allowed_thread_anchors.end_state: wider shot reveals the rope connecting vessel, dock or shoreline threshold

lover.reading: Contact, proximity, softness, care, texture, reciprocity. Lover shows two marine or yacht-adjacent surfaces meeting, altering each other and leaving a brief trace.
anchor_principles: Contact must be reciprocal.
A visible trace must form and begin to fade.
Avoid sunset romance and lifestyle advertising.
Human fragments allowed only if anonymous and non-sensual.
Materials should show tactile contrast.

rebel.reading: Interruption, rupture, deviation, reconfiguration, activation. Rebel/Catalyst is tension held inside a live system. It should not become aggression or big-wave spectacle.
anchor_principles: Show tension before release.
Prefer sailing systems, rigging, sail, hull, spray and controlled force.
Adrenaline is latent, not explosive.
Body fragments may appear only as anonymous contact points.
Avoid surf, storm and impact language.

visionary.reading: Latent order, emergence, perception shift, future pattern becoming visible through natural phenomena. Visionary differs from Sage: Sage reveals an order already present, Visionary shows an order forming in front of us.
anchor_principles: Pattern must form within the scene.
Phenomenon must be scientifically plausible.
Underwater is allowed only here.
Color must stay muted and naturalistic.
Avoid luminous network, portal and mystical geometry.

allowed_thread_anchors.name: sea_smoke_vertical_columns
allowed_thread_anchors.physical_description: Real sea smoke: thin vertical columns of visible water vapor rising from a warmer dark sea surface into colder air, caused by condensation and thermal contrast.
allowed_thread_anchors.start_state: dark calm sea at dawn, surface initially quiet
allowed_thread_anchors.evolve_state: thin vertical vapor filaments begin rising from the surface
allowed_thread_anchors.end_state: wide shot reveals many low vertical fog columns across the water, slightly bent by a breeze then returning upright
allowed_thread_anchors.generator_prompt_seed: Use concrete meteorological language: thin vertical vapor columns rising from a warmer dark sea surface into cold air, visible condensation, thermal gradient, low dawn light, slight bending from air currents. Do not use ethereal, spectral, ghostly, mystical, magical, or dreamlike language. Do not write the raw anchor id in final scene prompts.

preferred_transformations: static material -> living or physical process revealed
visionary.known_failure_mode: iridescent patch -> glowing network -> submerged city or transcendent grid
